title: Bar Ulla, synagogue attendant
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the beginning of Yoma, chapter 7, and at the end of Megillah, chapter 4, halakhah 5, Rabbi Yosa instructed Bar Ulla, attendant of the Babylonians’ synagogue, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Megillah 4:5 paragraph has Rabbi Yosa instructing an existing synagogue attendant about Torah-scroll handling; it does not describe appointing him to the office.

The whole Guggenheimer Megillah 4:5 paragraph fully names Rabbi Yosa instructing Bar Ulla, attendant of the Babylonians’ synagogue. It supports the local title and instruction direction, rather than appointment to office, as in the retained note. Hyman’s separate beginning-of-Yoma-chapter-7 pointer was not freshly collated.
